components.css: .ds-menu{position:relative;font-family:"IBM Plex Sans","Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink,#26362f)}.ds-menu summary{list-style:none;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer}.ds-menu summary:hover,.ds-menu[open] summary{background:var(--hover,#eaf0eb)}.ds-menu-popup{position:absolute;top:28px;left:0;min-width:235px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e0e7e1);border-radius:5px;background:var(--surface,#fff);box-shadow:0 6px 18px #0002;z-index:20}.ds-menu-popup button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;background:none;border:0;border-radius:5px;padding:8px 12px;text-align:left;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-menu-popup button:hover{background:var(--hover,#eaf0eb)}.ds-menu-popup span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#627269);margin-left:30px}.ds-menu summary:focus-visible,.ds-menu-popup button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#286449);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Merge workflow
components.description: Four ordered task steps in the original workspace, with current and completed states.
components.css: .ds-workflow{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#e6e9ed);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e6e9ed);background:#f9fbfd}.ds-workflow ol{display:flex;gap:22px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}.ds-workflow button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border:0;background:none;color:#627084;font:inherit;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.ds-workflow button span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;background:#e9edf3;color:#5c6878;font-size:11px}.ds-workflow .ds-current button{color:#2d5b98;font-weight:500}.ds-workflow .ds-current span{background:#3465a7;color:white}.ds-workflow .ds-complete span{background:transparent;color:#4d7560}.ds-workflow button:disabled{color:#778392;cursor:default;opacity:1}.ds-workflow button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#e8ecf1}.ds-workflow button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3465a7;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Reorderable page card
components.description: Retained page-image card with outer multi-selection, insertion mark, and keyboard/button move alternatives.
components.html: Page 2
components.css: .ds-page-card{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;position:relative;width:160px;background:#d9e6f8;outline:1px solid #81a1cc;border-radius:5px;padding:5px;cursor:grab}.ds-page-card.ds-before:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-8px;width:3px;background:#3465a7;border-radius:2px;pointer-events:none}.ds-page-card.ds-dragging{opacity:.5}.ds-page-preview{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:5px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;cursor:grab}.ds-page-paper{display:block;min-height:170px;width:100%;background:white;color:#344b69;padding-top:18px;font-size:12px}.ds-page-label{display:flex;gap:8px;width:100%;min-width:0;text-align:left}.ds-page-label strong{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:#344b69}.ds-page-label>span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px;color:#5c6878}.ds-page-preview:hover{background:#dce5f1}.ds-page-preview:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3465a7;outline-offset:1px}.ds-page-moves{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:3px 4px 0;font-size:11px;color:#5c6878}.ds-page-moves button{width:25px;min-height:25px;padding:4px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-page-moves button:hover{background:#e8ecf1}.ds-page-moves button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3465a7;outline-offset:3px}.ds-page-check{position:absolute;left:10px;top:10px;z-index:2;background:#f8faff;padding:3px;border-radius:4px;display:flex}.ds-page-check input{margin:0;accent-color:#3465a7}

components.name: Page selection toolbar
components.description: Sticky batch selection and delete/duplicate/extract controls; becomes non-sticky on compact screens.
components.css: .ds-selection{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;position:sticky;top:-1px;z-index:4;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:7px 9px;background:#f4f7fc;border-radius:5px;min-height:41px}.ds-selection label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-right:auto;font-size:11px;color:#465d7b}.ds-selection input{accent-color:#3465a7}.ds-selection button{font:inherit;font-size:11px;min-height:27px;padding:5px 7px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:#252a32;cursor:pointer}.ds-selection button:hover{background:#e8ecf1}.ds-selection .ds-delete:hover{background:#f6e5e3;color:#a03f36}.ds-selection button:focus-visible,.ds-selection input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3465a7;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-selection{position:static}}

components.name: Document action dialog
components.description: Shared password and split modal: compact fields, inline validation, processing label, and download-request completion. Passwords match, require at least eight characters, and are not persisted; AES-256 creates a protected copy. Split ranges or every page export numbered PDF parts as a ZIP without changing the workspace.
components.html:
Add password

Save a protected copy. A password will be required to open it.

Use at least 8 characters. iFixPDF does not store it.
components.css: .ds-dialog{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;width:min(440px,calc(100vw - 32px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 32px);overflow:auto;border:1px solid #c8d2df;border-radius:8px;padding:24px;color:#252a32;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 40px #17223133}.ds-dialog header,.ds-dialog footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.ds-dialog h2{font-size:18px;font-weight:600}.ds-dialog p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#526174}.ds-dialog label{display:block;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:17px}.ds-dialog input{display:block;width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d9dfe6;border-radius:5px;margin-top:7px;font:inherit}.ds-dialog small{font-size:11px;line-height:1.65;color:#526174}.ds-dialog footer{justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:22px}.ds-dialog button{font:inherit;font-size:12px;min-height:32px;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #e6e9ed;border-radius:5px;background:white;color:#252a32;cursor:pointer}.ds-dialog button:hover{background:#e8ecf1}.ds-dialog .ds-primary{background:#3465a7;color:white}.ds-dialog .ds-primary:hover{background:#28568f}.ds-dialog button:focus-visible,.ds-dialog input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3465a7;outline-offset:3px}.ds-dialog .ds-error{color:#a03930;font-size:12px}.ds-dialog button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}

components.name: iFixPDF identity
components.description: Static folded F mark and IBM Plex Sans 600 wordmark. Original titlebar mark is 24px; alternate titlebars use 22px. Standalone SVG lockup embeds its font.
components.html: iFixPDF

narrative.overview: The preferred original blue-grey framed-sheet editor retains its white workspace and three-pane composition, refined with real source thumbnails, fit-whole-page preview, page-number input, persistent custom export ranges, and export summary. Its matching Home is a flat recent-PDF list in the same shell, with row selection, Merge selected, and a right-click/More actions menu. Password and split dialogs download copies while preserving the workspace. Print Jobs and This Session / Project Pack navigation have been removed; visible Combine labels now say Merge while legacy internal keys remain. Alternate green Explorer and charcoal/amber workbench concepts remain separately documented. The Tauri/Rust shell is uncompiled on Windows.
keyCharacteristics: Bundled IBM Plex Sans and Lucide icons
Guided merge stages and individually reorderable pages within the original frame
Retained keyed page thumbnails, multi-selection, and undo/redo
Dedicated read-only Preview and separate Edit PDF workspace
Home row selection and keyboard-accessible document action menus
AES-256 password-protected copies and split-to-ZIP downloads without workspace changes

rules.name: The Concept Boundary Rule
rules.body: Each concept owns its palette and composition.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Resting panes remain flat; transient notifications, open menu popovers, and modal dialogs use shadows.

rules.name: The Fixed Identity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the folded F geometry, solid blue tile, pale fold, and iFixPDF spelling across concepts; scale the supplied artwork proportionally and keep it static.

dos: Do preserve final cascade and responsive overrides.
Do preserve visible focus and reduced motion.
donts: Don't add promotional bands, website navigation, or a website footer.
Don't add shadows to resting paper, cards, navigation, or panes.
Don't claim native Windows print or installer verification.
